retrievalProfile.description: A narrative scene featuring a traditional western cowboy leaning against a brick wall in a modern urban alleyway at night.

recipe.visualDefinition: A detailed realist painting of a cowboy with a wide-brimmed hat and vest leaning against a red brick building. The setting is a narrow city alley at night, illuminated by a warm light source from an unseen doorway or window, creating long shadows on the sidewalk and highlighting an awning in the background.
coreVisualRelationships: cowboy figure leaning against the left-side brick wall
diagonal light beam cutting across the alley floor
receding perspective of the alley towards a dark city street
contrast between the rustic western attire and the industrial urban architecture
coreInvariants: cowboy character with a large hat and vest
nocturnal lighting with a strong directional light source

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The cowboy is positioned on the left third of the frame, standing full-height and leaning against the wall.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The cowboy's face and hat, highlighted by the ambient light.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the cowboy, follows the diagonal light across the ground to the awning on the right, and then moves up to the title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, shadowy areas of the alley on the right and the upper corners provide space for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and brick reds of the architecture.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm golden-yellow from the artificial light source.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-key lighting with high contrast between the illuminated alley floor and the deep shadows of the buildings.
